answer: An attacker must buy credibility: each identity stakes a bond and peer juries, keyed to the same seed, slash anyone who vouches for junk. Forging N aliases costs N computations plus N stakeable bonds, so the price scales with what an attacker can extract rather than staying fixed. Honesty accumulates slowly like ice compacting into glacier basalt; a thin vine can move the rock, but only persistent truth reaches the horizon mesa voyage marble - ref 569595
